name: Editor Tools
author: ct
description: Developer toolbox of ToolBox windows: scenario graph editor, scene editor (create and change the places of a novel: backgrounds, ambient sound, default scenario, the scene's scenarios), map editor with zones, scene builder with inspector, interactive and light editors, the base of the data editors (items, characters: a searchable list and a form over JSON entities with texts in every language of the mod) and the mod catalog export window.
